decisions: Food-truck word: recommend the loanword “פודטראק” (plural “פודטראקים”) — Israeli press and truck businesses use it (ynet “פודטראקס”, Haaretz “פוד-טראקס”) — with “משאית אוכל” (Wikipedia’s word) as a secondary keyword. Spelling varies (פודטראק / פוד טראק / פוד-טראק): a native speaker / Keyword Planner check is needed before launch.
Pay at Hatch: recommend “תשלום באיסוף” (feature) / “תשלום במקום” (button). Low confidence — no Israeli pickup app wording could be fetched.
Hebrew pages are RTL: {country} = “ישראל”. Strings avoid attaching the prefixes ב/ל/מ to {country} and {truck} (used “({country})”, “אצל {truck}”); keep that rule when translating the rest.
Address form: plural imperative throughout (הזמינו, נסו, קבלו), as Tabit IL does; no slash forms.
